english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for doing something directly, including going somewhere without an intermediary or speaking plainly.
This is the all-purpose choice for going directly somewhere without a detour or stop.

examples.english: I directly called him, so there was no need to pass it on through someone else.
examples.traditional: 我直接打電話畀佢，唔使經人轉告。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zik6 zip3 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 keoi5 m4 sai2 ging1 jan4 zyun2 gou3

examples.english: Go straight to the airport; you don't need to stop.
examples.jyutping: nei5 zik6 zip3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 m4 sai2 ting4

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone says something bluntly or without holding back.

examples.english: Tell me flat out; there’s no need to beat around the bush.
examples.traditional: 你直接同我講，唔使兜圈子。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zik6 zip3 tung4 ngo5 gong2 m4 sai2 dau1 hyun1 zi2
